stories.title: Maricarmen podrá volver a casa tras alcanzar un acuerdo con Urbagestión

en.title: Maricarmen to return home after reaching agreement with Urbagestión
en.summary: An 87-year-old woman who was evicted from her Madrid apartment will be allowed to return after representatives reached an agreement during talks mediated by the city's housing authority.

stories.title: El Gobierno quiere prorrogar dos años los alquileres y prohibir los desahucios hasta 2028

en.title: Government seeks to extend rental agreements for two years and ban evictions until 2028
en.summary: The government plans to present a housing decree to cabinet aimed at addressing housing emergency concerns, following a recent eviction case that sparked public reaction.

stories.title: Urbagestión llega a un acuerdo con los representantes de Maricarmen para que vuelva a su casa

en.title: Urbagestión reaches agreement with Maricarmen's representatives for her return home
en.summary: The property company agreed to allow an 87-year-old woman to return to her Madrid apartment at approximately 500 euros monthly rent, pending her approval of the terms.

stories.title: Negociación de vértigo para pactar un decreto de vivienda que habría sido imposible sin Maricarmen

en.title: Intense negotiations to reach housing decree agreement that would have been impossible without Maricarmen
en.summary: Left-wing parties and other political groups are negotiating terms of housing protections legislation, with various demands on eviction protections and rental contracts, though consensus appears possible.

stories.title: El Papa, sobre Maricarmen: “¿Cuál es el problema en el sistema que permite que una anciana sea echada de su casa?”

en.title: The Pope on Maricarmen: "What is the problem in the system that allows an elderly woman to be evicted from her home?"
en.summary: The Pope commented to press about evictions, acknowledging he was unaware of the specific case, and called for more just solutions and investigation into the systemic causes of the problem.

stories.title: Maricarmen y Urbagestión alcanzan un acuerdo para que la anciana vuelva a su casa

en.title: Maricarmen and Urbagestión reach an agreement for the elderly woman to return to her home
en.summary: Municipal housing authorities mediated negotiations that resulted in an agreement allowing an elderly woman to return to her residence, pending her validation of the terms.

stories.title: El megacohete de SpaceX Starship alcanza la órbita terrestre por primera vez y explota durante el amerizaje

en.title: SpaceX's Starship mega-rocket reaches Earth orbit for the first time and explodes during splashdown
en.summary: During its fourteenth test flight, SpaceX's Starship successfully reached orbital altitude and deployed 26 Starlink satellites before catching fire during Pacific Ocean splashdown, marking progress toward NASA's lunar missions and Mars exploration goals.

stories.title: El PSOE plantea limitar la prórroga de los alquileres a dos años y prohibición de los desahucios a vulnerables y Junts se desmarca del texto: "Da por buenas las ocupaciones"

en.title: PSOE proposes limiting rental extensions to two years and prohibiting evictions of vulnerable people; Junts distances itself from the text: "It accepts occupations as valid"
en.summary: Spain's Socialist party proposed legislation capping rental renewals and protecting vulnerable tenants from eviction, but the Catalan Junts party rejected the proposal, arguing it implicitly condones illegal occupations.

stories.title: El Gobierno plantea a los socios prohibir los desahucios a personas vulnerables hasta 2028 y prorrogar dos años los alquileres

en.title: Government proposes to partners banning evictions of vulnerable people until 2028 and extending rental contracts by two years
en.summary: The Housing Ministry has drafted a proposal to limit rental contract updates to 2% annually and introduce tax deductions for tenants in high-demand areas, while preventing evictions of vulnerable households through 2028.

stories.title: Los cinco interrogantes del caso Maricarmen sobre el acuerdo para que vuelva a su casa

en.title: Five questions in the Maricarmen case regarding an agreement for her to return home
en.summary: The elderly woman's lawyer, property representatives, and municipal mediators met to negotiate an agreement regarding the return of an elderly resident to her residence.

stories.title: El delegado del Gobierno en Ceuta deja la política: “Mi familia no merece que yo siga”

en.title: The Government's delegate in Ceuta leaves politics: "My family doesn't deserve this to continue"
en.summary: The Government's delegate in Ceuta, Miguel Ángel Pérez Triano, is stepping down from politics after reporting a harassment campaign involving insults and threats, stating he had warned the Executive weeks prior.

stories.title: El delegado en Ceuta solicitó al Gobierno refuerzos ante el agravamiento de la presión migratoria una semana antes de la avalancha

en.title: Ceuta delegate requested Government reinforcements before migration pressure worsened a week before the surge
en.summary: Socialist Party members in Ceuta sought assistance from the Government starting July 28, reporting that the migrant situation was unsustainable and overwhelming.

stories.title: Furnells (Oesía) pide a Europa definir "requisitos comunes" para optimizar el gasto militar y hacer crecer la industria

en.title: Furnells (Oesía) asks Europe to define "common requirements" to optimize military spending and boost industry
en.summary: Furnells requested that European authorities establish common standards for military expenditures to enhance efficiency and support industrial growth.

stories.title: Maricarmen alcanza un acuerdo con Urbagestión para volver a su casa

en.title: Maricarmen reaches agreement with Urbagestión to return to her home
en.summary: An 87-year-old resident from Madrid's Retiro neighborhood has reached an agreement with Urbagestión that allows her to return to her residence.

stories.title: TotalEnergies sube el dividendo tras el alza del precio del crudo

en.title: TotalEnergies raises dividend following crude oil price increase
en.summary: The energy group expects a strong increase in free cash flow in the coming years as it raises its dividend in response to higher crude oil prices.

stories.title: Iberdrola suma 100.000 clientes al comprar Contigo

en.title: Iberdrola adds 100,000 customers by purchasing Contigo
en.summary: Iberdrola has acquired Contigo Energía, previously known as Gesternova, adding 100,000 customers to its portfolio. The company was founded in 2017.

stories.title: La defensa de Andic pide que declare Miquel Roca por el proyecto de fundación

en.title: Andic's defense requests Miquel Roca testify regarding foundation project
en.summary: The defense team for Cristóbal Martell has asked the judge to call Miquel Roca to testify about a charitable foundation project that Mango founder Isak Andic commissioned, which may be connected to his alleged murder by his son Jonathan.
